You have attempted this same task before and did not succeed. These are the plans you wrote after those attempts.
Trial #1: New plan: I failed because I tracked the books for everyone individually, which made me lose track of the specific book Dave was holding after every single swap. Instead of updating the state of all seven people, I should have maintained a single, running variable for "Dave's current book" and only updated it when Dave was involved in a swap. For every swap not involving Dave, I should have explicitly noted that Dave's book remained unchanged. By focusing exclusively on Dave's ownership history, I would have correctly identified that he ended up with Frankenstein without getting lost in the details of the other players.
